title: Travel Domain Stress-Test Stressors & Boundary Filters
scopeLimits: Models the 4 extreme friction dimensions of travel as an analytical stress-test for collective market formation.
limitations: Conceptual environment model; does not reflect live consumer bookings.

accessibility.altText: A diagram contrasting trivial commodity aggregation with the high-heterogeneity, high-perishability stress testing of the travel domain.
accessibility.textEquivalent: Commodity aggregation vs. Travel stress testing: Travel tests non-linear dates, family constraints, zero-refund perishability, and severe dissolution costs to expose mechanism limits.
